title: Concept: pyproject dependency declared from a git remote
description: pyproject.toml declares a `name @ git+…` dependency, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The installed code sits outside index publication controls and can move with the branch the reference names.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: The installed code sits outside index publication controls and can move with the branch the reference names.
